domain: Adjudication pass — reconciles tension between prior-round findings that target the same decision, ruling whether they contradict (pick-one) or compound (both hold), and correcting imprecise premises without discarding the underlying substantive point.
axioms: Two findings at one decision point are not automatically in tension — independent, compounding objections to the same conclusion both stand.
A finding's stated premise can be imprecise while its substantive conclusion remains correct; correct the premise, keep the point.
A deferred trigger condition that arrives inside the same committed plan is not a future contingency but a present decision owed now.
failure_mode: Adjudicates only findings already surfaced by prior lenses — introduces no new location or defect of its own, so it inherits the parents' blind spots.
Can over-reconcile, declaring compounding where a genuine pick-one tradeoff was owed.
